$comment: Per-game identity, read by CMake, Gradle and the publish pipeline. On a game branch set title/slug/description here. Leave bundleId out unless you need a specific one — the pipeline derives <bundle_id_prefix>.<slug>, which keeps games from overwriting each other on a device.
title: Zero Line
description: Draw a line through neighbouring numbers that add up to zero. 5×5 board, 60 seconds.
